revisions.local: integrated uncommitted source handoffs; content hashes authoritative

configuration.quantiles: nearest rank of 21 batch means, 3 scans per batch

limitations: Shared inputs contain only email/compact E.164 phone; upstream PII toggle also scans IP/cards/SSN/IBAN and has different phone semantics.
Literal scaling has no upstream counterpart; no equivalent speedup claim.
N-API JSON excludes parse/UTF-16 conversion; bridge and local hook include those. JS paths include awaited dispatch for each invocation.
Tool-result hooks are actually registered callbacks, not a live Pi runtime/provider, file operation, or full request pipeline; upstream hook includes its stats re-scan.

Per-row setup excludes module import/build/npm/source acquisition; those are separate one-off cold diagnostics. First-call measurements are diagnostic, not a fresh-process cold startup distribution. Local TypeScript module imports occur before timing.
Timing defaults with correctness misses is diagnostic only, never a speed-win comparison.
UTF-8 target sizes rounded up to complete chunks; Unicode corpus uses emoji/CJK/accent prose around ASCII detectors.
One machine and one sequential run; small timings include scheduling/JIT/GC noise; batch means are not individual-call latency tails.

setupEvidence.note: One fresh build/temporary npm cache, shared machine Cargo registry cache may be warm; not hot-scan latency.
